bullets.text: Sky ISP Reviews Abound - Multiple reviews highlight Sky's ISP offerings, showcasing their competitive edge in the UK market.
Openreach Calls for Regulation Changes - Openreach's MD advocates for softer **Ofcom** regulations in competitive areas.
Sky UK’s Legal Setback - A court has rejected **Sky**'s challenge against **Ofcom**'s new pay TV notification rules.
EE Users Face Connectivity Issues - Some **EE** customers report problems with router connectivity on their 1.6Gbps broadband.
CommunityFibre Launches eSIM Plan - **CommunityFibre** introduces a new data roaming eSIM mobile plan for UK users.
Fibrus Completes Major Contract - **Fibrus** announces the completion of a £200m fibre broadband contract in Northern Ireland.
